title: DSH Plugin Store catalog
description: The registry index for the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Register a plugin by adding one entry to plugins[] (via a pull request to catalog.json). A Plugin Store (or any federated store) reads this file through its manifestUrl config.

name.description: npm package name — the install spec (e.g. @linxin666/dsh-ssh).

description.description: One-line description shown in the list.

category.description: suite | ops | ui | productivity | theme | dev | fun | other (displayed localized).

logo.description: Emoji, a single letter, or an image URL.

members.description: Constituent packages when this entry is a suite/bundle (members are not listed separately).

repository.description: Source repository URL, shown for trust before install.
